paragraphs.text: Dissension , the third set in the original Ravnica block , introduced the final three guilds of the plane: the law-driven Azorius Senate , the chaotic Cult of Rakdos , and the experimental Simic Combine . To highlight each guild's mechanics and playstyle, Wizards of the Coast released three preconstructed theme decks alongside the set in May 2006. These decks provided players with ready-to-play introductions to each guild, showcasing mechanics such as forecast , hellbent , and graft , while offering flavorful strategies that reflected their guild's identities.
Azorius Ascendant is a theme deck from Dissension .
The two rares in this deck are Isperia the Inscrutable and Wakestone Gargoyle .
Rakdos Bloodsport is a theme deck from Dissension .
The two rares in this deck are Lyzolda, the Blood Witch and Nihilistic Glee .
Simic Mutology is a theme deck from Dissension .
The two rares in this deck are Experiment Kraj and Protean Hulk .
